title: GlotEval: A Test Suite for Massively Multilingual Evaluation of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing ChrF scores separately for translated sentences marked with masculine and feminine grammatical genders to detect if the machine translation system favors one gender form over the other.

Evaluating large language models across a massively multilingual suite covering over 1,500 languages (including low-resource and marginalized variants) and utilizing non-English-centric translation setups to measure performance discrepancies and biases favoring dominant or high-resource languages.
Testing models on the Global-MMLU benchmark, which focuses on culture-aware question answering to assess and address cultural biases in knowledge evaluations.
